**From PageRank to the vision stack**

从 PageRank 到视觉栈

::: {.uni-intro}
A university whose CS department became the launching pad for Google and whose lecture notes trained a generation of AI researchers.
:::

> 这所学校的计算机系是 Google 的起跑线，它的讲义培训了一代又一代 AI 研究者。

## Why it matters <span class='zh-inline'>(为何重要)</span>

Stanford's CS culture turns research directly into infrastructure and into the lecture notes the world learns from.

> 斯坦福的 CS 文化把研究直接变成基础设施，也变成全世界学习的讲义。

## Background <span class='zh-inline'>(背景)</span>

Founded in 1885 by Leland and Jane Stanford as a memorial to their son, the university opened on 1 October 1891. Its location in Silicon Valley shaped a department closely tied to industry.

> 斯坦福大学由 Leland 与 Jane Stanford 于 1885 年创办以纪念他们的儿子，1891 年 10 月 1 日开学。位于硅谷的地理位置塑造了它与产业界紧密相连的计算机系。

## People <span class='zh-inline'>(人物)</span>

| Person | Connection to computing |
|:--|:--|
| Sergey Brin | Stanford graduate students who co-developed PageRank and co-founded Google in 1998 |
| Fei-Fei Li | Stanford professor and lead instructor of CS231n |
| Andrew Ng | Stanford adjunct professor and longtime instructor of CS229 |

> **Larry Page** 与 **Sergey Brin** — 斯坦福研究生，共同开发 PageRank 并于 1998 年创办 Google。**李飞飞** — 斯坦福教授，CS231n 主讲。**Andrew Ng** — 斯坦福兼职教授，长期主讲 CS229。

| Course | Title |
|:--|:--|
| CS106A | Programming Methodology |
| CS161 | Design and Analysis of Algorithms |
| CS107 | Programming Paradigms |

## In this book <span class='zh-inline'>(本书收录)</span>

- [002 · TCP (CS144)](https://github.com/polarours/Coursework/tree/master/problems/002-stanford-cs144-tcp)
- [007 · Compiler (CS143)](https://github.com/polarours/Coursework/tree/master/problems/007-stanford-cs143-compiler)
- [009 · Cryptography (CS155)](https://github.com/polarours/Coursework/tree/master/problems/009-stanford-cs155-crypto)
- [010 · Raytracer (CS248)](https://github.com/polarours/Coursework/tree/master/problems/010-stanford-cs248-raytracer)
- [011 · Neural networks (CS231n)](https://github.com/polarours/Coursework/tree/master/problems/011-stanford-cs231n-neuralnet)
- [015 · Boggle (CS106B)](https://github.com/polarours/Coursework/tree/master/problems/015-stanford-cs106b-boggle)
- [021 · Kruskal MST](https://github.com/polarours/Coursework/tree/master/problems/021-stanford-kruskal)
- [022 · CS106L-style workshop](https://github.com/polarours/Coursework/tree/master/problems/022-cs106l-scoped-handle)

**From CS144's TCP to CS231n's neural networks, the Stanford projects here trace the path from networks to AI that the department itself helped define.**

> 从 CS144 的 TCP 到 CS231n 的神经网络，本书的斯坦福项目复刻了这条从网络到 AI 的路径——这条路径正是该系参与定义的。
